## Checklist

- [ ] PR is opened from a feature branch into `main`.
- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits, for example `feat: add health endpoints`.
- [ ] README or other docs were updated when behavior, commands, or setup changed.
- [ ] `.env.example` was updated when environment variables changed.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, local config, or generated artifacts are committed.
- [ ] Docker, runtime, or deployment changes were verified locally when applicable.
- [ ] Reviewers can understand the scope from this description.
